lessons: Tests must drive main(['drain']) and main(['serve']) with a fake ProcessExec that emits stream-json events and an injected clock. Calling compose_pipeline(watchdog=True) directly does not prove the roots bind the wrapper.

Add drain reconciliation tests. Reconcile must run before the first dispatch and after every dispatch. A configured notify must use SubprocessNotifications with no provider auth keys in its env. Unset notify must warn once and send nothing.

Git status in _call's finally misses committed work. Diff base...HEAD plus the worktree instead, or use the filesystem seam, so committed edits count as progress.
Never let the mutation observation raise out of a finally block; it would replace the driver's original exception.

Keep what already passed: the notify identities, the Drain reconcile_notifications wiring, WatchdogLLM without a detector abort, and the Stages bind/clear. Most of the remaining work is root-level tests plus the mutation fix.
